intent: Inspect and refactor TelemetryLedgerRepository without changing its ast_hints API: verify layering (domain types only in ports, no blocking calls, no hardcoded config values), reactive lifecycle/backpressure, and that tests stay green. Unit: Context Telemetry Event Ledger. Outbound repository port, append-only: no update/delete methods. append stores the revision (unique recordId+revisionNumber; duplicate errors). findLatest returns the highest revision of a record (empty if none). findRevisions returns all revisions in revisionNumber order (audit trail). findHistory returns revisions by device and metric with deviceTimestamp in [from,to] ordered by deviceTimestamp.
